web.title: Public holidays fact sheet - Fair Work Ombudsman
web.description:
# Public holidays fact sheet
## What payment is required for not working on a public holiday?
Full-time and part-time employees are entitled to be paid their base pay rate for their ordinary hours if they are absent from work because of a public holiday.

An employee is not entitled to payment if they do not have ordinary hours of work on the public holiday.

For example, a part-time employee is not entitled to payment if their part-time hours do not include the day of the week on which the public holiday falls.

# Not working on public holidays
## Base pay rates
Under the [National Employment Standards](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/national-employment-standards) (NES), employees (except casual employees) who normally work on the day a public holiday falls will be paid their base pay rate for the ordinary hours they would have worked if they had not been away because of the public holiday.
